name: Tameeni Insurance
verdict: An online insurance platform wholly owned by Rasan, a Saudi fintech listed on the Saudi Exchange; its IPO prospectus names only individuals and private funds as substantial shareholders.
note: Insurance aggregator and e-brokerage platform (not an underwriter). Present on several Saudi shirts (front/back): chest patch on Al Faisaly's 2026-27 home shirt. Proposed none 2026-10-03.
